# uniconn — LLM & AI Agent API Reference

> Universal async-first Python library (Python 3.11+) and CLI for executing commands, inspecting host facts, enforcing idempotent states, and managing files across SSH, Telnet, Serial/UART, IPMI BMC, Redfish BMC (`niquests`), Docker/Podman, Kubernetes (`kubectl`), Replay, and Local transports.

## Quick Facts & Commands
- Package manager: `uv`
- Install all dependencies: `uv sync`
- Run unit tests (context-saving output): `uv run pytest -m "not integration" -q --tb=short | tail -n 5`
- Re-run failed unit tests with traceback: `uv run pytest -m "not integration" -q --tb=short --lf | tail -n 30`
- Run latency & overhead benchmarks: `python -m benchmarks.overhead_bench --check-thresholds`
- Lint & typecheck: `uv run ruff check src/` and `uv run pyright` (or `uv run poe check`)
- Task runner: `uv run poe check`, `uv run poe bench`, `uv run poe test`
- Preview dashboard server: `uv run python main.py --serve` (listens on `0.0.0.0:3000`)
- Documentation & Feature Matrix: `AGENTS.md` (architecture & rules), `FEATURES.md` (full catalog of implemented features — consult on-demand only)

## Public Exports (`from uniconn import ...`)
- **Core & Facade**: `Connection`, `SyncConnection`, `ConnectionConfig`, `SecretResolver`, `URIParser`, `Result`, `PingResult`, `SyncResult`, `EnsureResult`, `HostFacts`, `FactSpec`, `CustomCommandSpec`, `FileSourceSpec`, `ExternalToolSpec`, `ExternalToolRunner`, `FactsDiffReport`, `DiskInfo`, `NetworkInterface`, `diff_facts`, `render_template`, `OperationObserver`, `ObserverContext`, `HostTempManager`, `ScriptExecutionManager`, `BeforeRunHook`, `AfterRunHook`, `OnErrorHook`, `HookCallback`, `HookEvent`
- **Resilience (`uniconn.core.resilience`)**: `CircuitBreaker`, `CircuitState`, `RateLimiter`, `CircuitBreakerMiddleware`, `RateLimitMiddleware`
- **Domain Services (`uniconn.services` / `uniconn.pool`)**: `FileOperationsService`, `DirectorySynchronizer`, `TemplateEngine`, `StateManagementService`, `FactCollector`, `TunnelService`, `PoolFileOperationsService`, `PoolStateManagementService`, `SyncFileOperationsService`, `SyncStateManagementService`, `SyncTunnelService`, `SyncPoolFileOperationsService`, `SyncPoolStateManagementService`
- **Strategies (`uniconn.services.provisioning`)**: `PackageManagerStrategy`, `AptStrategy`, `ApkStrategy`, `DnfYumStrategy`, `PacmanStrategy`, `ZypperStrategy`, `ServiceManagerStrategy`, `SystemdStrategy`, `OpenRCStrategy`, `SysVStrategy`
- **Middleware Pipeline & Context (`uniconn.core`)**: `CommandRequest`, `CommandPipeline`, `CommandMiddleware`, `ContextMiddleware`, `SudoMiddleware`, `HookMiddleware`, `DryRunMiddleware`, `ObservabilityMiddleware`, `CircuitBreakerMiddleware`, `RateLimitMiddleware`, `RetryMiddleware`, `TracingMiddleware`, `ExecutionContext`, `EventLoopPortal`, `SyncContextBridge`, `InventoryLoader`
- **Transport Protocols, BMC, Container/K8s, Replay/Cassette & Helpers (`uniconn.transports` / `uniconn.pytest_plugin`)**: `BaseTransport`, `CommandTransport`, `FileCapableTransport`, `FileStat`, `ShellCapableTransport`, `ShellProcessProtocol`, `ShellStdinProtocol`, `ShellStdoutProtocol`, `TunnelCapableTransport`, `require_capability`, `supports_capability`, `SerialTransport`, `SerialPortInfo`, `list_serial_ports`, `IPMITransport`, `RedfishTransport`, `DockerTransport`, `PodmanTransport`, `KubectlTransport`, `LocalTransport`, `ReplayTransport`, `CassetteTransportProxy`, `Cassette`, `CassetteDiffReport`, `InteractionDiff`, `CassetteContext`, `SyncCassetteContext`, `UniconnCassetteFixture`, `RecordMode`, `RecordedExecInteraction`, `RecordedStreamInteraction`, `RecordedFsInteraction`, `RecordedShellInteraction`, `ShellDialogStep`, `ReplayShellProcess`, `normalize_temp_paths`, `OpenSSHConfigParser`, `SSHJumpChainManager`, `SFTPClientAdapter`
- **Pools**: `ConnectionPool`, `SyncConnectionPool`, `PoolFileOperationsService`, `PoolStateManagementService`, `SyncPoolFileOperationsService`, `SyncPoolStateManagementService`, `PoolStreamMultiplexer`, `SSHSessionPool`
- **Interactive PTY Shell (`uniconn.shell`)**: `ShellSession`, `SyncShellSession`, `PosixMarkerProtocol`, `ExpectStateMachine`
- **Background Diagnostics, Streaming Logs & Pluggable Backends (`uniconn.background`)**: `DiagnosticSession`, `SyncDiagnosticSession`, `DiagnosticConfig`, `DiagnosticResult`, `StreamSourceSpec`, `DirectStreamCollector`, `LogPipeline`, `LogHandler`, `LocalFileHandler`, `ForwardHandler`, `StreamHandler`, `ArchiveHandler`, `BackgroundPool`, `BackgroundPoolConfig`, `BackgroundSession`, `BackgroundResult`, `BackgroundCleanupManager`, `BackgroundLogCollector`, `BackgroundBackendStrategy`, `TmuxBackend`, `ScreenBackend`, `NohupBackend`, `WindowsJobBackend`, `resolve_backend`, `LogConfig`
- **Hooks & OpenTelemetry (`uniconn.hooks` / `uniconn.telemetry`)**: `audit_log_hook`, `allowlist_hook`, `blocklist_hook`, `MetricsCollector`, `metrics_collector_hook`, `structured_log_hook`, `OtelTracingHook`, `otel_tracing_hook`, `InMemoryTracer`, `RecordedSpan`, `SpanProtocol`, `TracerProtocol`, `get_current_span`
- **Logging (`structlog` + `stdlib`)**: `configure_logging`, `get_struct_logger`, `log_context`, `bind_log_context`, `unbind_log_context`, `clear_log_context`, `get_log_context`, `get_logger`, `setup_file_logging`, `SecretMaskingFilter`
- **Exceptions**: `UniconnError`, `ConfigurationError`, `ConnectionError`, `CircuitOpenError`, `BatchAbortedError`, `CassetteError`, `CassetteMissError`, `AuthenticationError`, `ExecutionError`, `FileTransferError`, `TimeoutError`, `TransportNotFoundError`, `CapabilityNotSupportedError`, `BMCCapabilityError`, `BackgroundError`, `BackgroundBackendError`, `BackgroundSessionExistsError`, `BackgroundPoolFullError`

## URI Schemes & Secret Resolution (`SecretResolver`)
- `ssh://[user[:password]@]host[:22][?key_file=...&password=env://SSH_PASS&known_hosts=strict&keepalive=30&ssh_config=true&use_agent=true&proxy=jump1,jump2&proxy_command=...&rate_limit=10&circuit_breaker_threshold=5&circuit_breaker_timeout=30]`
- `docker://[user@]container_name_or_id[?runtime=docker|podman&context=...&docker_host=...&workdir=/app&shell=/bin/sh]`
- `podman://[user@]container_name_or_id[?workdir=/app&shell=/bin/sh]`
- `kubectl://[namespace/]pod_name[?container=app&context=prod&kubeconfig=/path/to/config&namespace=default&workdir=/app]`
- `local://[?timeout=30&rate_limit=10&circuit_breaker_threshold=5]`
- `telnet://[user[:password]@]host[:23][?term_type=vt100]`
- `serial:///dev/ttyUSB0[?baudrate=115200&parity=N&stopbits=1]` or `uart://COM3[:115200][?parity=even&stopbits=1.5&vid=10c4&pid=ea60]`
- `ipmi://admin:password@bmc-host[:623]`
- `redfish://admin:password@bmc-host[:443][?verify_ssl=false&system_id=1&chassis_id=1&manager_id=1&auth=auto&multiplexed=true]`
- `replay://host[?cassette=path/to/cassette.yaml&mode=none&normalize_temp=true&allow_playback_repeats=true]`
- **Secret URI References (`v0.12.0+`)**: `password`, `options["passphrase"]`, `options["sudo_password"]`, `options["key_file"]`, and arbitrary values in `InventoryLoader` (YAML/TOML/JSON) support `env://VAR_NAME[?default=fallback]` and `file:///path/to/secret[?default=fallback]`. Missing secrets without `?default=` raise `ConfigurationError`.

## Core API Signatures

### `Connection` (Async) & `SyncConnection` (`conn.to_sync()`)
```python
# Factories (available on both Connection and SyncConnection)
conn = Connection.from_uri(
    uri: str,
    retry_attempts: int = 3,
    logger=None,
    dry_run: bool = False,
    rate_limit: float | RateLimiter | None = None,
    circuit_breaker: bool | CircuitBreaker | None = None,
)
conn = Connection.from_config(config: ConnectionConfig, ...)
conn = Connection.from_dict(data: dict, ...)
conns = Connection.from_file(path: str | Path, *, host: str | None = None, group: str | None = None)
conn = Connection.from_inventory(path: str | Path, host: str)
sync_conn = SyncConnection.from_uri(uri: str, ...)

# Cloning (available on both Connection and SyncConnection)
conn2 = conn.copy(host=..., port=..., username=..., password=..., timeout=..., dry_run=...)
conn2 = conn.with_overrides(**overrides)

# Execution & Scripts
res: Result = await conn.run(
    command: str | Sequence[str],
    timeout: float | None = None,
    raise_on_error: bool = False,
    input: str | bytes | None = None,
    sudo: bool = False,
    sudo_user: str | None = None,
    sudo_password: str | SecretStr | None = None,
    sensitive: bool = False,
    dry_run: bool | None = None,
    **kwargs,  # cwd, env
)
raw: bytes = await conn.run_bytes(command, timeout=None, raise_on_error=False, input=None, sudo=False, **kwargs)
results: list[Result] = await conn.run_commands(commands: Sequence[str | Sequence[str]], stop_on_error: bool = True, **kwargs)
script_res: Result = await conn.run_script(
    script_path: str | Path,
    args: Sequence[str] = (),
    *,
    interpreter: str | None,
    sudo: bool = False,
    timeout: float | None = None,
    raise_on_error: bool = False,
    **kwargs,
)
async for line in conn.stream(command, timeout=None, **kwargs): ...
alive: bool = await conn.is_alive(timeout=None)
ping_res: PingResult = await conn.ping(timeout=5.0)

# Wait Primitives (v0.16.0)
ping_res: PingResult = await conn.wait_for_connection(timeout=120.0, interval=2.0, delay=0.0)
elapsed: float = await conn.wait_for_port(
    port: int,
    *,
    host: str | None = None,
    state: Literal["open", "closed"] = "open",
    check_from: Literal["remote", "local"] = "remote",
    timeout: float = 60.0,
    interval: float = 1.0,
    delay: float = 0.0,
)
elapsed: float = await conn.wait_for_path(
    remote_path: str | Path,
    *,
    state: Literal["present", "absent"] = "present",
    content_regex: str | None = None,
    timeout: float = 60.0,
    interval: float = 1.0,
    delay: float = 0.0,
    sudo: bool = False,
)

# Host Inspection, Declarative FactSpec & DiagnosticSession (v0.8.0+)
facts: HostFacts = await conn.gather_facts(
    refresh: bool = False,
    timeout: float | None = None,
    spec: FactSpec | Mapping[str, Any] | str | Path | None = None,
    artifact_dir: str | Path | None = None,
    ttl: float | None = None,
)
async with conn.diagnostic_session(
    config: DiagnosticConfig | Mapping[str, Any] | str | Path | None = None,
    *,
    spec: FactSpec | Mapping[str, Any] | str | Path | None = None,
    streams: Sequence[StreamSourceSpec | Mapping[str, Any] | str] | None = None,
    local_dir: str | Path = "./diagnostics",
    archive_path: str | Path | None = None,
    archive_format: Literal["tar.gz", "zip", "none"] = "tar.gz",
    forward_to: Connection | str | None = None,
    forward_remote_dir: str = "/tmp/uniconn_diagnostics",
    fsync_realtime: bool = True,
) as diag:
    await diag.emit_custom_log("stress", "Starting stress-ng workload")
    await diag.snapshot("mid_load")

# Idempotent State Management & Unified Diff via `conn.state` (v0.8.0 / v0.12.0 / v0.15.0)
pkg_res: EnsureResult = await conn.state.ensure_package(package, state="present", manager="auto", update_cache=False, sudo=True, dry_run=None)
svc_res: EnsureResult = await conn.state.ensure_service(service, state="started", enabled=None, sudo=True, dry_run=None)
line_res: EnsureResult = await conn.state.ensure_line(remote_path, line, state="present", regex=None, create=True, backup=False, mode=None, dry_run=None)
file_res: EnsureResult = await conn.state.ensure_file(
    remote_path: str,
    *,
    state: Literal["present", "absent", "link"] = "present",
    content: str | bytes | None = None,
    target: str | None = None,
    mode: int | None = None,
    owner: str | None = None,
    group: str | None = None,
    backup: bool = False,
    validate: str | None = None,  # e.g. "nginx -t -c %s"
    sudo: bool = False,
    atomic: bool = False,
    dry_run: bool | None = None,
)
dir_res: EnsureResult = await conn.state.ensure_directory(
    remote_path: str,
    *,
    state: Literal["present", "absent"] = "present",
    mode: int | None = None,
    owner: str | None = None,
    group: str | None = None,
    recurse: bool = False,
    sudo: bool = False,
    dry_run: bool | None = None,
)
user_res: EnsureResult = await conn.state.ensure_user(
    username: str,
    *,
    state: Literal["present", "absent"] = "present",
    uid: int | None = None,
    gid: int | str | None = None,
    groups: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    append_groups: bool = False,
    shell: str | None = None,
    home: str | Path | None = None,
    create_home: bool = True,
    system: bool = False,
    comment: str | None = None,
    sudo: bool = True,
    dry_run: bool | None = None,
)
key_res: EnsureResult = await conn.state.ensure_authorized_key(
    user: str,
    key: str,
    *,
    state: Literal["present", "absent"] = "present",
    exclusive: bool = False,
    path: str | Path | None = None,
    sudo: bool = False,
    dry_run: bool | None = None,
)
unit_res: EnsureResult = await conn.state.ensure_systemd_unit(
    name: str,
    content: str | None = None,
    *,
    state: Literal["started", "stopped", "restarted", "reloaded", "present", "absent"] = "started",
    enabled: bool | None = True,
    unit_dir: str | Path = "/etc/systemd/system",
    daemon_reload: bool = True,
    sudo: bool = True,
    dry_run: bool | None = None,
)
sysctl_res: EnsureResult = await conn.state.ensure_sysctl(
    key: str,
    value: str | int,
    *,
    state: Literal["present", "absent"] = "present",
    persist: bool = True,
    config_file: str | Path = "/etc/sysctl.d/99-uniconn.conf",
    reload: bool = True,
    sudo: bool = True,
    dry_run: bool | None = None,
)

# Declarative Expect (SSH, Telnet, Serial/UART, Local)
res: Result = await conn.expect(
    command: str | Sequence[str],
    patterns: Mapping[str, str | SecretStr] | None = None,
    final_prompt: str | None = None,
    timeout: float | None = None,
    line_ending: str = "\n",
    sensitive: bool = False,
)

# SSH Port Forwarding via `conn.tunnels` (Async & Sync context managers)
async with conn.tunnels.forward_local_port(remote_host="127.0.0.1", remote_port=5432, local_host="127.0.0.1", local_port=0) as bound_port:
    ...
async with conn.tunnels.forward_remote_port(remote_host="127.0.0.1", remote_port=0, local_host="127.0.0.1", local_port=8000) as bound_port:
    ...

# Context Managers (work with both `async with` and `with` for cd/env)
async with conn.cd("/var/www"), conn.env(APP_ENV="prod"):
    await conn.run(["./deploy.sh"])

async with conn.temp_dir(prefix="uniconn_") as tmp_path:
    await conn.files.write_file(f"{tmp_path}/data.txt", "hello")

# Contract Testing & Cassette Recording/Replay (v0.10.0 / v0.12.0)
async with conn.use_cassette(
    "tests/cassettes/host_facts.yaml",
    mode="once",                  # "once" | "new_episodes" | "none" | "all"
    match_on=("command", "cwd", "sudo"),
    normalize_temp=True,
    allow_playback_repeats=True,
    mask_secrets=True,
) as cassette:
    facts = await conn.gather_facts()

diff_report: CassetteDiffReport = cassette.diff(other_cassette)

# Lifecycle Hooks & Operation Observers
conn.add_hook("before_run", callback)  # callback(command_str, host, kwargs)
conn.add_hook("after_run", callback)   # callback(result: Result)
conn.add_hook("on_error", callback)    # callback(exc, command_str, host)
conn.add_operation_observer(observer)
conn.remove_operation_observer(observer)
with conn.using_observer(observer):    # Also works with `async with conn.using_observer(observer):`
    await conn.files.read_file("/etc/hostname")

# File Operations, Smart Directory Sync & Templating via `conn.files` (SFTP & Local)
content: str | bytes = await conn.files.read_file(remote_path, encoding="utf-8")  # encoding=None -> bytes
await conn.files.write_file(remote_path, content: str | bytes, mode: int | None = None, encoding="utf-8", *, atomic: bool = False)
await conn.files.remove_file(remote_path)
exists: bool = await conn.files.exists(remote_path)
await conn.files.mkdir(remote_path, parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=None)
await conn.files.upload(local_path, remote_path, recurse=False, *, verify: bool = False, progress_callback=None)
await conn.files.download(remote_path, local_path, recurse=False, *, verify: bool = False, progress_callback=None)
digest: str = await conn.files.checksum(remote_path, algorithm="sha256", *, sudo=False)
await conn.files.chmod(remote_path, 0o755)
info: dict = await conn.files.stat(remote_path)
names: list[str] = await conn.files.listdir(remote_path=".")
sync_res: SyncResult = await conn.files.sync_dir(
    local_dir,
    remote_dir,
    delete=False,
    exclude=["*.pyc", ".git"],
    *,
    checksum_check: bool = False,
    preserve_permissions: bool = False,
)
rendered: str = await conn.files.write_template(remote_path, template_str_or_path, context={...}, mode=0o644, engine="auto", *, atomic: bool = False)

# Stateful PTY Shell (SSH, Local, Telnet, Serial)
async with await conn.open_shell(term_type="xterm", term_size=(80, 24), init_posix=None) as shell:
    await shell.execute("cd /var/log")
    r = await shell.execute("pwd")  # r.text == "/var/log"
    r_exp = await shell.expect("fdisk /dev/sda", patterns={r"Command \(m for help\):": "q\n"})
    await shell.resize(120, 40)

# Serial / UART Hardware Controls, Binary I/O & Sensor Streaming
async with Connection.from_uri("uart://COM3:115200?parity=even&stopbits=1.5") as s_conn:
    # Binary I/O (Modbus RTU, framing with inter_byte_timeout)
    pdu_resp: bytes = await s_conn.run_bytes(b"\x01\x03\x00\x00\x00\x02\xc4\x0b", inter_byte_timeout=0.02)
    # Passive stream (NMEA GPS, sensor stream)
    async for line in s_conn.stream():
        print("Sensor:", line)
    # Hardware reset (ESP32/Arduino) and BREAK signal (U-Boot/ROMMON)
    await s_conn.transport.pulse_dtr_rts(dtr=False, rts=True, duration=0.1)
    s_conn.transport.send_break(duration=0.25)
    cts_active: bool = s_conn.transport.get_cts()
```

### `Result`, `PingResult`, `SyncResult`, `EnsureResult`, `HostFacts`, `FactsDiffReport` & `CassetteDiffReport`
- `Result`: `exit_code: int`, `stdout: str`, `stderr: str`, `duration: float`, `command: str`, `host: str | None`, `ok: bool`, `text: str` (`stdout.strip()`), `lines: list[str]`, `sensitive: bool`, `raw_bytes: bytes`, `result.json() -> Any`, `result.raise_for_status() -> Self`, `result.to_dict() -> dict`
- `PingResult`: `host: str`, `alive: bool`, `latency_ms: float`, `transport: str`, `error: str | None`, `bool(ping_res) == ping_res.alive`, `ping_res.to_dict() -> dict`
- `SyncResult`: `uploaded: list[str]`, `skipped: list[str]`, `deleted: list[str]`, `bytes_transferred: int`, `duration: float`, `dry_run: bool`, `total_checked: int`, `sync_res.to_dict() -> dict`
- `EnsureResult`: `target: str`, `state: str`, `changed: bool`, `ok: bool`, `details: str`, `dry_run: bool`, `diff: str | None = None`, `ensure_res.to_dict() -> dict`
- `HostFacts`: `os_family: str`, `distro: str`, `kernel: str`, `arch: str`, `hostname: str`, `uptime_seconds: float`, `cpu_count: int`, `memory_total_bytes: int`, `memory_available_bytes: int`, `disks: list[DiskInfo]`, `interfaces: list[NetworkInterface]`, `facts.to_dict() -> dict`
- `FactsDiffReport`: `baseline_host: str`, `hosts_checked: int`, `is_homogeneous: bool`, `mismatches: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]`, `facts: dict[str, HostFacts]`, `report.to_dict() -> dict`
- `CassetteDiffReport`: `left_target: str`, `right_target: str`, `is_identical: bool`, `left_total: int`, `right_total: int`, `added_interactions: list[str]`, `removed_interactions: list[str]`, `modified_interactions: list[InteractionDiff]`, `report.to_dict() -> dict`

### `ConnectionPool` & `SyncConnectionPool` (`pool.to_sync()`)
```python
pool = ConnectionPool(
    uris_or_conns,
    max_concurrent=10,
    retry_attempts=3,
    rate_limit=None,           # float (ops/sec) or RateLimiter
    circuit_breaker=False,
    failure_threshold=5,
    recovery_timeout=30.0,
    batch_size=None,           # wave/batch rollout size (int | None)
    max_fail_ratio=0.0,        # max allowed failure ratio per batch (0.0..1.0); raises BatchAbortedError
)
pool = ConnectionPool.from_file(
    "inventory.yaml",
    group="web",
    max_concurrent=10,
    rate_limit=20.0,
    circuit_breaker=True,
    batch_size=2,
    max_fail_ratio=0.25,
)

async with pool:  # Keeps connections open across multiple pool operations
    # Subset selection (reuses active connections without closing parent pool on sub-pool close)
    canary_pool = pool.select(["web-1"], predicate=lambda key, conn: "web" in key)
    # Fleet cassette recording/replay: directory per host (<dir>/<host>.yaml) or single shared file (.yaml/.yml/.json)
    async with pool.use_cassette("tests/cassettes/fleet_dir", mode="once") as cassettes_by_host:
        results: list[Result] = await pool.map("uptime", sudo=True, batch_size=2, max_fail_ratio=0.25)
    safe_map: dict[str, Result | Exception] = await pool.map_safe("uptime")
    ping_map: dict[str, PingResult] = await pool.ping(timeout=5.0)
    conn_map: dict[str, PingResult] = await pool.wait_for_connection(timeout=120.0, interval=2.0)
    port_map: dict[str, float] = await pool.wait_for_port(443, state="open", check_from="remote")
    path_map: dict[str, float] = await pool.wait_for_path("/tmp/ready", content_regex="OK")
    script_map: dict[str, Result | Exception] = await pool.run_script("./check.sh", args=["--fast"])
    facts_map: dict[str, HostFacts] = await pool.gather_facts()
    diff_rep: FactsDiffReport = await pool.diff_facts(baseline=None)
    line_map: dict[str, EnsureResult] = await pool.state.ensure_line("/etc/hosts", "10.0.0.5 db.internal")
    file_map: dict[str, EnsureResult] = await pool.state.ensure_file("/etc/app.conf", content="port=8080\n", mode=0o644, atomic=True)
    dir_map: dict[str, EnsureResult] = await pool.state.ensure_directory("/var/lib/app", mode=0o755)
    user_map: dict[str, EnsureResult] = await pool.state.ensure_user("deploy", groups=["docker"], shell="/bin/bash")
    key_map: dict[str, EnsureResult] = await pool.state.ensure_authorized_key("deploy", "ssh-ed25519 AAAA...")
    unit_map: dict[str, EnsureResult] = await pool.state.ensure_systemd_unit("myapp.service", "[Unit]\n...")
    sysctl_map: dict[str, EnsureResult] = await pool.state.ensure_sysctl("net.ipv4.ip_forward", 1)
    async for host, line in pool.stream("journalctl -f -n 5"):
        print(host, line)
    await pool.files.upload("./app.conf", "/etc/app/app.conf", verify=True)
    paths: dict[str, str] = await pool.files.download("/var/log/syslog", "./logs/{host}.log", verify=True)
    hashes: dict[str, str] = await pool.files.checksum("/etc/app/app.conf", algorithm="sha256")
    sync_map: dict[str, SyncResult] = await pool.files.sync_dir("./dist", "/var/www/app", delete=True, exclude=["*.pyc"])
    tpl_map: dict[str, str] = await pool.files.write_template("/etc/app.conf", "./app.conf.tpl", context={"port": 8080}, atomic=True)
    custom = await pool.apply(lambda c: c.run("hostname"))

with pool.to_sync() as sync_pool:
    with sync_pool.use_cassette("tests/cassettes/fleet_dir", mode="once") as cassettes_by_host:
        ping_map = sync_pool.ping()
    diff_rep = sync_pool.diff_facts()
    for host, line in sync_pool.stream("tail -n 5 /var/log/syslog"):
        print(host, line)
```

### `SSHSessionPool` (Single-host SSH channel multiplexing with adaptive concurrency)
```python
async with SSHSessionPool(
    "ssh://user@host",
    max_sessions_per_conn=6,
    max_connections=6,
    health_check=True,
    rate_limit=50.0,
    circuit_breaker=True,
    failure_threshold=5,
    recovery_timeout=30.0,
    adaptive=True,            # auto-scales down on MaxSessions / MaxStartups rejections
    min_sessions_per_conn=1,
) as pool:
    res = await pool.run("uptime")
    results = await pool.map(["lshw", "dmidecode", "nvme list"])
    await pool.resize(max_sessions_per_conn=2, max_connections=2)  # graceful drain of excess connections
    stats = pool.stats()
    healthy_count = await pool.check_health()
```

### Built-in Hooks & OpenTelemetry Tracing (`uniconn.hooks`)
```python
from uniconn.hooks import (
    audit_log_hook,
    allowlist_hook,
    blocklist_hook,
    metrics_collector_hook,
    otel_tracing_hook,
)

conn.add_hook("before_run", allowlist_hook(["ls", "cat", "uptime", "systemctl status"]))
conn.add_hook("before_run", blocklist_hook(["rm -rf /", "mkfs", "shutdown"]))
conn.add_hook("after_run", audit_log_hook("/var/log/uniconn_audit.jsonl", include_output=True, mask_secrets=True))

metrics = metrics_collector_hook()
metrics.attach(conn)  # registers after_run and on_error

otel = otel_tracing_hook(service_name="uniconn", record_output=False, mask_secrets=True)
otel.attach(conn)     # instruments run(), upload(), download(), read_file(), write_file(), sync_dir(), open_shell(), stream()
```

### Pytest Plugin & Cassette Testing (`uniconn.pytest_plugin`)
```python
# In pytest tests:
import pytest
from uniconn import Connection

# 1. Automatic cassette record/replay via marker:
@pytest.mark.uniconn_cassette  # auto-names to cassettes/<test_file>/<test_name>.yaml
async def test_fleet_inspection():
    conn = Connection.from_uri("ssh://node-01")  # automatically wrapped in CassetteTransportProxy
    res = await conn.run("uptime")
    assert res.ok

# 2. Explicit cassette fixture usage:
@pytest.mark.uniconn_cassette("edge_node.yaml", mode="once")
async def test_custom_cassette(uniconn_cassette):
    conn = Connection.from_uri("ssh://node-01")
    async with uniconn_cassette.use(conn) as cass:
        await conn.run("hostname")
    assert cass.total_interactions == 1

# 3. Direct replay connection without real network:
async def test_replay_flow(uniconn_cassette):
    replay_conn = uniconn_cassette.connection("fixtures/cassettes/edge_node.yaml")
    res = await replay_conn.run("hostname")
    assert res.ok
```

### CLI Cassette, Provisioning & Rollout Commands
```bash
# Record commands/scripts into cassette:
uniconn record ssh://user@host -c ./cassettes/node.yaml -- uptime
uniconn record ssh://user@host -c ./cassettes/node.yaml --mode all --sanitize-ip -- script.sh

# Replay commands from cassette without network:
uniconn replay ./cassettes/node.yaml -- uptime
uniconn replay ./cassettes/node.yaml  # prints cassette metadata and interaction summary

# Manage, sanitize, verify, and diff cassettes:
uniconn cassette info ./cassettes/node.yaml [--format json]
uniconn cassette sanitize ./cassettes/node.yaml [--output clean.yaml] [--redact-ip] [--redact-tokens]
uniconn cassette verify ./cassettes/node.yaml
uniconn cassette diff ./cassettes/baseline.yaml ./cassettes/candidate.yaml [--format table|json] [--fail-on-diff]

# File integrity & system provisioning CLI commands (v0.15.0):
uniconn checksum /etc/nginx/nginx.conf ssh://node-01 [--algorithm sha256|sha1|md5] [--sudo] [--format table|json]
uniconn ensure-user deploy ssh://node-01 [--state present|absent] [--uid 1050] [--groups docker,sudo] [--shell /bin/bash] [--dry-run]
uniconn ensure-authorized-key deploy "ssh-ed25519 AAAA..." ssh://node-01 [--state present|absent] [--sudo] [--dry-run]
uniconn ensure-unit myapp.service ssh://node-01 [--file ./myapp.service | --content "..."] [--state started] [--enabled] [--dry-run]
uniconn ensure-sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward 1 ssh://node-01 [--config-file /etc/sysctl.d/99-uniconn.conf] [--dry-run]

# Wait primitives & wave/batch rollout flags (v0.16.0):
uniconn wait-for connection ssh://node-01 [--timeout 120] [--interval 2] [--format table|json]
uniconn wait-for port 5432 ssh://node-01 [--state open|closed] [--check-from remote|local] [--timeout 60]
uniconn wait-for path /tmp/ready.flag ssh://node-01 [--state present|absent] [--regex "READY"] [--sudo]
uniconn run-multi ssh://node-01 ssh://node-02 -c "deploy.sh" --batch-size 1 --max-fail-ratio 0.0
```
